synthesis:draft.headline: Operational demand is the region‑level demand the dispatch system attributes to local scheduled/semi‑scheduled/significant non‑scheduled generation, scheduled bidirectional units and interconnector imports, and it excludes local scheduled loads.

document_statements.paraphrase: Operational demand in a region is the demand met by local scheduled, semi‑scheduled and significant non‑scheduled generation, by generation from scheduled bidirectional units, and by generation imports to the region; it excludes the demand of local scheduled loads and scheduled bidirectional units, and includes Wholesale Demand Response.

document_statements.quote: Measured operational demand is field “OPERATIONAL_DEMAND” in EMMS Data Model, as described in Appendix A2.
Scheduled loads mean normally-off scheduled loads3.

document_statements.paraphrase: When Wholesale Demand Response is dispatched, the measured operational demand values for the other components will decrease by the amount of dispatched Wholesale Demand Response.

document_statements.quote: Process MTPASA uses 10% and 50% POE operational demand forecasts for modelling.
